description:
Cast Twinflame with Strive by paying {3}{R}{R}, targeting Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask.
Holding priority, cast Fork by paying {R}{R}, creating a copy of Twinflame.
Resolve the Twinflame copy, creating a token copy of Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask.
Revolutionist and Priest of Urabrask enters the battlefield triggers.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Fork from your graveyard to hand.
Resolve the Priest of Urabrask trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat from step 2.
